editorial:
Imagine rushing home for a family emergency only to find that your grandpa has vanished into thin air. That is exactly what happens to Noble in this wild ride. You get to follow her and her group of weird best friends as they try to track down PawPaw. The best part is definitely the hood-Aunty who joins the search. She adds a ton of energy and laughs to the group, making the whole trip feel like a chaotic family vacation gone wrong. It feels like a big, warm hug of a movie that does not take itself too seriously, blending a mystery with plenty of heart.

You will love how the movie keeps you guessing with strange clues and funny side characters. The acting feels real, and the jokes land perfectly without feeling forced. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the fast pace keeps you from caring.
endingExplained: You find out that PawPaw was not kidnapped at all. He actually staged his own disappearance to bring the family back together because he felt lonely. He left a trail of clues that led Noble and her friends to his favorite old fishing spot. After a big emotional reunion, the family realizes they need to spend more time together. The movie ends with a huge family dinner where everyone finally gets along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and lighthearted mysteries.
